text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the new year, and Mejiro Dober has invited me to participate in the Mejiro family's first shrine visit of the year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: This year's shrine visit feels so different and exciting with the addition of your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't you agree, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-why're you asking me? There's nothing exciting about doing the same old shrine visit every year…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I guess. Doing annual traditions like this together is nice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway, enough of that…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But more importantly…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Red bean soup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Red bean soup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I see plenty of treats for sale at this year's stalls!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Didn't you say your New Year's resolution is to cut back on desserts?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why, the year has only just begun! I must simply ensure that I consume less on average throughout the rest of the year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I-is that how it works?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: They have such interesting charms nowadays. And look what protections they offer: "Everything's Gonna Be All Right." Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Apparently the shrine's been trying to appeal to young people. Pics of these charms are all over Umasta!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You sure know a lot, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, I wonder what the meaning of this one is? "Party Luck F-R-F-R"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Pffthaha! Sorry, it sounds hilarious when you say it, Ardan. Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Talk about free-spirited…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: They seem to be enjoying themselves quite a bit. We can't lose out to them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What kind of competition even is this…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, what do you think we should do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Are you even listening to me?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Amazake! What a wonderful idea! That certainly will help warm our hearts and bodies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Would you like some too, Dober? There's nothing better than a cozy shrine visit to start off the year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haha, never heard a shrine visit described as "cozy" before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It looks like they're selling it over there, so let's go get some.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We all enjoy our amazake and end our shrine visit feeling very warm and fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: A charm! They've piqued my interest too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Why don't we all get matching ones to mark the occasion of our coming here together, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? I don't know about that… I don't mind getting one with you, Bright, but all three of us? That's too embarrassing…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Really? But isn't getting matching charms a hallmark of youth? The characters in the manga you lent me did the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's different! Oh, fine. Whatever! Let's just go get some!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spend the rest of our shrine visit deciding which charm to buy, and ultimately we choose the one for certain victory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: That's a fabulous place to start. What will you be wishing for, then?
choice_data_list: For Dober to become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-don't just say it all casually like that! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …You never change, do you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Exactly the answer I expected from your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Exactly the answer I expected from your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait… Aren't you supposed to keep your wish a secret?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: If you want for something to come true fervently enough, I don't think it matters if you tell others about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And knowing your trainer, there won't be a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …I guess that's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's pray for each other's success in our senior year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. A wonderful idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We all stand in a line and pray for smooth sailing in their upcoming senior year!
